entities.summary: Akli Tadjer, a Franco-Algerian writer, was born on August 11, 1954, in Paris, of Algerian immigrant parents. His first novel, Al-Tassili, was published in 1985, for which he won the Georges Brassens Prize for Literary Creativity.
